context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 tested the NEW Rapid Reps Safety Check system - a mandatory trainer verification system for in-person sessions using QR codes. All safety-check endpoints under /api/safety-check/* are fully functional. Key implementation notes: 1) Token security uses SHA-256 hashing with 5-minute expiry, 2) Virtual sessions don't require verification (canStart=true, requiresVerification=false), 3) Outdoor/in-home sessions require QR verification before starting, 4) Admin can override verification manually, 5) Fixed a datetime timezone bug during testing. The trainer must be verified via /api/admin/verifications/{userId}/approve (not the /admin/trainers/{id}/verify endpoint which uses profile _id). Frontend files exist but UI was not tested.
